scenes.title: Chosen as Queen of Persia
scenes.english_text: Long ago in Persia, a beautiful young Jewish orphan girl named Esther lived with her wise cousin Mordecai. When King Ahasuerus looked for a new queen, Esther was chosen for her grace, beauty, and gentle heart. Mordecai advised her to keep her Jewish heritage secret for a time, trusting in God's hidden providence.
scenes.tetum_translation: Iha tempu uluk iha Pérsia, labarik-feto faluk Judeu furak ida naran Ester hela ho nia maun-alin matenek Mordecai. Bainhira Liurai Assuero buka liurai-feto foun ida, Ester hetan hili tanba nia kmanek, bonitas, no laran-di'ak. Mordecai fó consello ba nia atu subar nia rasa Judeu ba tempu balu, fiar iha Maromak nia providénsia ne'ebé subar.
scenes.scene_summary: Young orphan Esther is chosen by King Ahasuerus to become the Queen of Persia.

scenes.title: Haman's Evil Decree
scenes.english_text: A proud official named Haman became angry because Mordecai would only bow to God, not to him. Haman tricked the king into signing a terrible law to destroy all the Jewish people in the kingdom. When Mordecai heard the news, he put on sackcloth, wept, and sent a message to Queen Esther urging her to speak to the king.
scenes.tetum_translation: Offisial foti-an ida naran Haman sai hirus tanba Mordecai hakru'uk de'it ba Maromak, la'ós ba nia. Haman lohi liurai atu assina ukun-fuan aat ida atu estraga ema Judeu hotu iha reinu laran. Bainhira Mordecai rona notisia ne'e, nia uza hena-saku, tanis, no haruka mensajen ba Liurai-Feto Ester hodi husu nia atu ko'alia ba liurai.
scenes.scene_summary: Haman plots to destroy the Jews, and Mordecai sends word to Queen Esther for help.

scenes.title: For Such a Time as This
scenes.english_text: Mordecai told Esther, 'Who knows whether you have come to royal position for such a time as this?' Though entering the king's presence uninvited could mean death, Esther bravely declared, 'If I perish, I perish.' She asked all the Jews to fast and pray with her for three days before she approached the king.
scenes.tetum_translation: Mordecai dehan ba Ester, 'Sé mak hatene se ó sai liurai-feto loloos ba tempu hanesan ne'e?' Maski tama ba liurai nia oin la ho konvite bele sosa mate, Ester deklara ho brani, 'Se ha'u mate, ha'u mate.' Nia husu ema Judeu hotu atu jejum no harohan ho nia ba loron tolu molok nia hakbesik ba liurai.
scenes.scene_summary: Esther calls for three days of fasting and prayer before risking her life to enter the King's presence.

scenes.title: Courage Before the King
scenes.english_text: On the third day, Queen Esther put on her royal robes and stepped into the inner court. King Ahasuerus smiled, held out his golden scepter, and spared her life. Esther invited the king and Haman to two special banquets, where she courageously revealed Haman's plot and pleaded for the lives of her people.
scenes.tetum_translation: Iha loron terseiru, Liurai-Feto Ester uza nia vestidu liurai nian no la'o tama ba pátiu laran. Liurai Assuero oin-haksolok, foti nia kbiit-ai (cetro) osan-mean ba nia, no salva nia moris. Ester convida liurai no Haman ba festa spesial rua, ne'ebé nia hatudu ho brani Haman nia planu aat no husu sadi'ak ba nia povu nia moris.
scenes.scene_summary: Queen Esther approaches King Ahasuerus, receives the golden scepter, and exposes Haman's evil scheme at a banquet.

scenes.title: Deliverance and Purim Joy
scenes.english_text: The king was furious at Haman's cruelty and saved the Jewish people, raising Mordecai to high honor instead. God's people celebrated their miraculous deliverance with great joy, feasting, and sending gifts to one another. Esther's courage was remembered forever as the feast of Purim.
scenes.tetum_translation: Liurai hirus tebes ba Haman nia laran-aat no salva ema Judeu sira, hodi foti Mordecai ba honra boot. Maromak nia povu celebra sira-nia salvasaun ho milagre ho ksolok boot, festa, no haruka prezente ba malu. Ester nia korajen hetan hanoin-hetan ba nafatin nu'udar festa Purim.
scenes.scene_summary: God saves the Jewish people through Esther's bravery, establishing the joyful celebration of Purim.

reflection.core_lesson_en: Esther shows us that God places us in specific places for a purpose, and we can stand up bravely for others when we trust Him.
reflection.core_lesson_tet: Ester hatudu mai ita katak Maromak tau ita iha fatin spesial ba motivu ida, no ita bele hamriik ho brani ba ema seluk bainhira ita fiar ba Nia.
reflection.discussion_question_en: When you see a classmate being treated unfairly this week, how can you show courage like Queen Esther to help them?
reflection.discussion_question_tet: Bainhira ó haree maluk eskola ida hetan hahalok injustu iha semana ne'e, oinsá ó bele hatudu korajen hanesan Liurai-Feto Ester atu ajulita sira?
